title: Daft Punk - Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger (Official Video)
summary: The official music video for Daft Punk's Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger, taken from Discovery. It is a chapter of the anime film Interstella 5000 supervised by Leiji Matsumoto.
why: Mostly used as a joke reference to the song's lyrics in AI threads, and cited for its robot-band theme in a thread about the song's tempo.

quote.text: This is thematically amazing when you consider what the song is about
